scene: Tucking the tube safely away, you exit onto the busy transit terrace.
picture: A flat side-view pixel art terrace under evening lamplight. On the far left, a yellow bicycle rickshaw waits by a striped awning. Left of centre stands the player holding his bag. At centre sits an idle cream-colored milk float. On the right, a glowing red ferris wheel gondola rests at a boarding gate.
shown: A yellow bicycle rickshaw with a canopy parked waiting on the far left
A low electric milk float stacked with rattling bottles sitting at centre
An open glowing ferris wheel gondola docked against the railing on the right

variants.scene: The scroll secured, you step into the purple twilight beside the giant wheel.
Humming {tune}, you step onto the platform where dusk settles over Pixel City.
